question: Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word: NONCHALANT
solution:
The correct answer is: **Unconcerned**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The word **"nonchalant"** means feeling or appearing casually calm and relaxed, showing no anxiety, interest, or enthusiasm. (निस्पृह)

 
 
• **Example:** Despite the tense situation, she remained nonchalant and handled everything with ease.
 

 
• **"Unconcerned"** refers to being indifferent or not involved; showing no interest or worry about something. (उदासीन)

 
 
• **Example:** He appeared unconcerned about the results of the exam, even
